blocks.text: What the area offers besides homes: the terminal, the markets, the Ocean Hub and the amenity core. Numbers refer to the views below.

blocks.heading: WHAT THE SITE OFFERS
paras: The East wing gives arrivals a terminal, with the fish and farmers’ markets beside it. The West wing holds the Ocean Hub, for diving, swimming lessons and marine research. Between them, an amenity core of kiosks, shops and a sports centre serves daily life.

blocks.heading: WHO IT SERVES
paras: Arrivals no longer wait for speedboats on the street. Residents learn to swim and dive at the Ocean Hub, and six dive sites within a 30-minute boat ride draw visitors from across Greater Malé. Shops, school and sport are all a short walk from home.
